sessions.phase_label: Kajabi landing-page polish, variant creation, and corrective revisions

requirements.title: Natural Top-Block Layout
requirements.definition: The top block must have a coherent layout without an empty-looking patch or media intruding into its text.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the top block's visual composition only; the independently testable media replacement and playback behavior belongs to REQ_TOP_SECTION_VIDEO.

requirements.title: Timeline Block Visual Separation
requirements.definition: The day-range blocks in the middle timeline section must remain visually distinguishable when displayed on a black background, using dividing lines or an equivalent separation treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: The black background and separators form one coupled visual-separation treatment. Image-to-heading alignment is independently testable and remains separate.

requirements.title: Timeline Images Aligned with Headings
requirements.definition: Images in the middle program-timeline blocks, including the 第 1-7 天 block, must align properly with their associated headings.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an alignment behavior independent of the section's background and block-divider treatment.

requirements.title: Correct Kajabi Page and Account Target
requirements.definition: Landing-page revisions must be applied to the intended enrollment page in the client's current Kajabi account, transferring prior work from the old account when necessary.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the implementation target and account migration rather than the individual visual changes performed on that page.

requirements.title: Top-Section Video Replacement and Playback
requirements.definition: The image in the top section must be replaced by the supplied video, and the resulting video must play in the page preview.
requirements.boundary_note: Video selection, embedding, and playback are one media mechanism; the surrounding top-block layout is separately testable.

requirements.title: Remove Week 8-9 Section
requirements.definition: The section titled 第 8-9 週：情緒界線（身體覺察）—羅盤🧭 must be absent from the landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: This named section can be removed independently of the Q&A and bonus sections.

requirements.title: Two-Panel Pricing Layout
requirements.definition: The most expensive pricing panel must be removed, leaving two panels, with the remaining layout restyled if necessary to avoid excessive side space.
requirements.boundary_note: Panel count and the layout adjustment caused by that count are tightly coupled; monthly-marker typography and mobile containment are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Monthly Price Marker Typography
requirements.definition: Each displayed pricing option must show the 月 monthly marker in smaller type than the numeric price.
requirements.boundary_note: The marker treatment has its own visual acceptance criterion and can change independently of pricing-panel count.

requirements.title: Remove Penultimate Q&A Box
requirements.definition: The penultimate Q&A box, directly above the final question about what to do when there are questions, must be removed.
requirements.boundary_note: This specific Q&A removal can be implemented and verified independently of other content deletions.

requirements.title: Create Updated Page Duplicate
requirements.definition: After the requested removals and styling changes, an updated duplicate of the landing page must be created.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers creation of the duplicate artifact; the duplicate's distinct pricing-section behavior is a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Duplicate Page Without Pricing Section
requirements.definition: The duplicate landing-page variant must omit the pricing section entirely while the non-duplicate variant retains it.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a persistent difference between page variants, not merely the one-off act of duplicating the page.

requirements.title: Secondary Jump Control Coverage
requirements.definition: A secondary control labeled 👇跳到課程內容介紹👇 must appear beneath every applicable primary button, including the first section.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers which sections receive the control and its label; visual styling, spacing, and navigation behavior can fail independently.

requirements.title: Secondary Jump Control Styling
requirements.definition: The secondary course-content control must use the supplied reference treatment without a conventional button wrapper.
requirements.boundary_note: The wrapper and visual treatment are independent of whether the control is present, correctly positioned, or linked.

requirements.title: Secondary Jump Control Placement and Spacing
requirements.definition: Each secondary course-content control must sit directly beneath its primary button with minimal vertical spacing rather than beside it or far below it.
requirements.boundary_note: Placement and spacing have a separate visual acceptance criterion from control styling and link behavior.

requirements.title: Secondary Control Section-Jump Navigation
requirements.definition: The secondary course-content control, or its 內容介紹 text, must link to the appropriate course-content section lower on the page.
requirements.boundary_note: The required outcome is section-jump navigation; whether it is implemented as a button or linked text is an implementation choice.

requirements.title: Remove Entire Bonus Section
requirements.definition: The entire bonus section, including its header text, must be absent from the applicable landing-page variant or variants.
requirements.boundary_note: The later header instruction completes the requested removal of the same section rather than defining a separate header-only Requirement.

requirements.title: Instructor Section Alignment
requirements.definition: The About Your Instructor section must remain properly aligned after the client's replacement photo is added.
requirements.boundary_note: This section has an independent alignment failure and does not share lifecycle state with other image or pricing layouts.

requirements.title: Desktop YouTube Link Placement
requirements.definition: The landing page must include a visible YouTube icon and link in the upper-right header area, following the referenced NimbusForge implementation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the standard upper-right link presentation; direct visibility in the mobile navigation path has a separate failure and fix trajectory.

requirements.title: Centered Pricing Subheader
requirements.definition: On the page retaining the pricing section, the specified pricing subheader text must be centered beneath its header.
requirements.boundary_note: This alignment rule is independently testable from panel count, monthly-marker typography, and mobile containment.

requirements.title: Directly Visible Mobile YouTube Link
requirements.definition: On mobile, the YouTube icon must be directly visible in the upper-right area without requiring the user to open a dropdown.
requirements.boundary_note: Mobile direct visibility follows a distinct responsive path and can fail or be fixed independently of desktop placement.

requirements.title: Mobile Pricing Panels Within Frame
requirements.definition: Pricing panels must fit within the mobile viewport without extending outside the page frame.
requirements.boundary_note: Responsive containment is independently verifiable and is not merely an attribute of the desktop two-panel layout.

unresolved_candidates.description: The instruction to copy the NimbusForge setup may entail behavior beyond the explicitly requested YouTube icon and link, but the supplied history does not define that additional behavior precisely enough for a separate Requirement.

The client requires both page variants to be reviewed but rejects the freelancer's assumption that every correction automatically applies to both. Exact variant scope remains unclear for the bonus-section and YouTube-link corrections, while the pricing-subheader instruction explicitly targets the page retaining pricing.
